title: Master Bedroom
prompt: Design a serene master bedroom centered on a queen bed with matching nightstands and reading lamps, a dresser against the opposite wall, and a soft rug underfoot for a calm.

title: Kitchen & Dining Room
prompt: Create a family kitchen built for cooking together - plenty of cabinet storage, a range and fridge grouped for an efficient work triangle, and a dining table with chairs for everyday meals.

title: Spa Bathroom
prompt: Create a spa-like bathroom centered on a freestanding soaking tub, with a separate shower, a sleek vanity with a large mirror, and calm, minimal finishes.

title: Family Dining Room
prompt: Create a warm family dining room with a sturdy wooden table and six chairs, a buffet for dishes and linens, and soft overhead lighting for everyday dinners.

title: Contemporary Kitchen
prompt: Design a compact contemporary kitchen with a range, refrigerator, and sink arranged efficiently, generous base cabinets, a narrow preparation island, and two stools for casual breakfasts.

title: Living Room
prompt: Create a relaxed conversation-focused living room with a sofa and two armchairs around a coffee table, a media console against one wall, and a floor lamp beside the seating area.

title: Home Office
prompt: Design a focused home office with a broad desk facing the window, an ergonomic chair, closed storage for supplies, and a reading chair with a floor lamp in one quiet corner.
